summary.result: The PM concentrations were increased from inlet to outlet vents resulting in 1,872 of TD, 1,385 of PM 10 , and 209 ㎍/㎥ of PM 2.5 , respectively.
summary.background: The concentration of particulate matter (PM) and harmful gases generated is also increasing inside livestock house.
summary.method: Concentrations of PM 10 , PM 2.5 , and TD (Total Dust) were monitored using personal air samplers with teflon filter during working and moving periods considering the ventilation systems of 6 broiler houses.
